title: Gorebound Hulk
subtitle: Strongman
text: At Degree 4, prepare the existing Gorebound Hulk offering and finish its Cardinal Ordeal. In my practical, anchor Guard inside this ring, keep the Hulk guarding for five seconds, and have it strike a rehearsal threat while guarding. The small head, lifting belt and heavy forearms belong to a constructed strongman; its existing strength and cost remain.
